title: CEDAR · The glow, explained wrong · III
venue: the novel of the timber country · never past the corner box · Box 14
logline: The third explanation, from a child on the dock: it's the mill. It never closed; it moved up the hill where nobody could see it, and it's running. The page draws the mill in the trees with its stack among the trunks and the whistle's shape coming down over the town at noon. Nobody hears it. The child does.
